Congress Wins Datia By-Election, Cites Key Support

The Congress party has won the Datia by-election. Congress leader Jitu Patwari attributed the victory to support from Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav, stating that a phone call from Yadav changed the outcome. Patwari also highlighted the margin of victory, noting that Congress candidate Ghanshyam Singh was leading by a record margin.
